Since the success of obligatory arbitration has been limited in practice, Baden-Württemberg did away with it on May 1st 2013.
Die wirtschaftliche Lage ist miserabel. Die Inflation ist 2022 extrem (fast 50 Prozent bei Nahrungsmitteln), das Wachstum bescheiden.
The economic situation is terrible. In 2022, inflation is severe (almost 50 percent for food), with little growth.
bescheiden.et: From Middle High German bescheiden (“to assign; to inform”). By surface analysis, be- + scheiden. The adjective was originally the past participle.

s: to confer the decision or fate formally, to announce, to proclaim

The outcome for demolishing housing is also sobering. Demolition applications for around 2,200 apartments have been approved.
to accept so as to become content with
Letzterer beschied sich seiner Unfähigkeit, über so hochwichtige Fragen zu richten.
The latter accepted his inability to judge such important issues.
Engelhart beschied sich dessen, daß er zurücktreten mußte.
Engelhart was resigned to the fact that he had to resign.

s: However painful, dealing resolutely with a problematic situation is preferable to allowing it to go on indefinitely.

decline in employment, fall in employment (a decrease in the total number of people employed within an economy, industry, or company)

Structural change in heavy industry led to a years-long decline in employment.
employment growth (an increase in the number of people in gainful employment within an economy or a specific sector over a given period)

collateralization, securitization (the process of pledging assets as a guarantee for the repayment of a loan or fulfillment of a contract)
Eine ausreichende Besicherung durch erstklassige Staatsanleihen reduziert das Kreditrisiko für den Gläubiger erheblich.
Sufficient collateralization with high-grade government bonds significantly reduces the credit risk for the creditor.
inventory management, holding of stock, asset holding (the act of keeping and managing a stock of goods, materials, or financial assets over time)

In the real estate sector, the company focuses primarily on the long-term asset holding of residential properties to generate steady rental income.

The property register in the land registry lists all parcels belonging to the plot of land.

Thanks to digital stock control, the current stock level can be checked in real time.

The legal property relations regarding the plot of land have been unclear for years.
Nach der Übernahme änderten sich die Besitzverhältnisse innerhalb des Konzerns grundlegend.
